method: Fresh offline browser per artifact. CDP process IDs and /proc/PID/status VmRSS sum sampled every 100 ms. RSS counts shared pages per process. CDP Performance metrics measure JS heap. Peaks can miss brief spikes. OS disk caches are uncontrolled.
limits: One final measured run per configuration plus development probes.
Chromium153 only. Viewports are not physical-phone tests.
Forced GC is diagnostic, never an application requirement.
